title.narrative: UNICEF's strategic promotion  and technical support to national and state governments has  supported the expansion of gender-equitable, sustainable, and safely managed water services across India, with a strong emphasis on climate-resilient service delivery. As a result, 29,17,790 people have gained access to safely managed drinking water services, and an additional 12,43,166 individuals now benefit from climate-resilient water supply systems that protect communities from the risks of climate change.
